newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA'S VILNIAUS BANK 1996 PROFIT RISES STEEPLY.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA'S VILNIAUS BANK 1996 PROFIT RISES STEEPLY.

text.p: Leading Lithuanian bank Vilniaus Bank said on Monday that its 1996 net profit rose to 24.4 million litas versus 2.9 million litas the previous year.
The bank also said in a statement that its share of the Lithuanian market doubled in 1996.
"In 1996, Vilniaus Bank's business volume increased significantly with a resulting higher market share," the bank said.

"Vilniaus Bank's assets as a percentage of total assets of the sector grew from 6.8 percent to 14.0 percent... the portion of total loans issued increased from 5.6 percent to 10.2 percent," the bank said.
The bank added that its market share of deposits almost tripled, from 4.8 percent to 13.7 percent.
